patches.why: The spec types an invoice item's net_amount as a bare integer, yet its own description says the field answers null for every discountable item, so the field is nullable.

The spec's personalization-design card_logo says "Must have a `purpose` value of `issuing_logo`", yet neither the File object's purpose nor the file upload's purpose lists it; Stripe's own guide uploads the logo with that purpose (https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/cards/physical/create-design.md?testing-method=with-code), so issuing_logo is a purpose a file has.

source.quote: Use the [Files API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/files/create.md) to upload a .PNG file of your card logo, and specify the purpose as `issuing_logo`.
